msg_set_tpm_note: Some information requires running as administrator.
msg_set_theme_tip: The window rebuilds immediately after you change the theme; "Original" keeps the previous colors.
msg_hint_card: Select a smart card to view details

msg_bak_dir: Save the smart card backup file (.tsb)
msg_bak_admin: Administrator rights are required for backup and restore. Please run this tool as administrator.
msg_bak_select: Please select a smart card in the list first
msg_bak_ok:
Backup completed

Backup file: %s
Data files: %s (%s)
Registry: %s item(s)

Note: the backup contains the card data, the device registry, the TPM key index, the device properties (card name and card GUID) and the DPAPI plaintext of the card key material, which is re-encrypted with the target machine's DPAPI on restore. The backup file is therefore equivalent to key material - keep it safe, together with the card name, PIN, PUK and admin key.
msg_rec_dir: Select the smart card backup file (.tsb)
msg_rec_bad: The backup is incomplete or its version is incompatible
msg_rec_exist: A card with instance %s already exists; restoring will overwrite its data. Deleting that card first is recommended.
msg_rec_confirm:
Restore this virtual smart card?

Card name: %s
Instance: %s
Backup time: %s

Restore will write back the card data and import the registry keys.
msg_rec_ok:
Restore completed

Data files: %s
Registry: %s item(s)

If the card does not appear in the list, please restart the system.
msg_rec_stale: Notice: %s backup file(s) failed the integrity check (may have been modified)
msg_rec_tpm_diff:
Warning: this backup was not created by this computer's TPM.

%s

The same TPM is a hard requirement for the on-card private key: continuing will only rebuild the card and its certificates — the private key cannot be recovered (its parent key lives inside the source TPM).

Continue the restore anyway?

Certificate export successful: %s
Note: Only the public key data of the select certificate is exported,
      The private key is encrypted by the TPM and can NOT be exported

msg_tips_cloud:
Please note that you have chosen to issue certificates using the cloud

Please provide the exchange key to the CA issuance platform
Then paste the issuance address in the [Cloud Addresses] field

Please note that you have chosen to deliver certificates with a pickup code

Upload the certificate on the CA delivery platform to generate a pickup code
Then enter the pickup code in the [Pickup code] field; the cloud address stays unchanged

msg_lang_tip:
Choose the interface language; the window rebuilds immediately after you apply.
To add a language, just drop a JSON pack into Config/locales.
msg_set_osc_tip: OpenSC is used to read smart card certificates. The installer is in the OpenSC folder next to this program; restart the program afterwards.
msg_osc_installed: OpenSC has been installed. The program will restart automatically.
msg_osc_fail:
OpenSC installation failed (exit code %s).

Possible reason: %s
Install log: %s

You can also run the installer manually: %s
msg_osc_fail_missing:
The installer was not found in the OpenSC folder next to this program, so it cannot be installed automatically.

Please install OpenSC manually, then restart the program.
msg_osc_reason_policy: The installation was refused by system policy, or this process has no administrator rights: Windows Installer rejects a per-machine install from a non-elevated process (exit code 1625). Run this program as administrator, or lift Installer\DisableMSI in group policy.
msg_osc_reason_admin: Administrator rights were not granted (the elevation prompt was cancelled or could not be shown). Run this program as administrator, then retry.
msg_osc_reason_other: Common causes: blocked by group policy, insufficient rights (run as administrator), another OpenSC version already installed, or the installer blocked by security software. See the install log.
msg_set_ssh_tip: The WinSSH agent lets smart card certificates authenticate SSH sessions. Installation uses Chocolatey and requires network access and administrator rights.
msg_set_ssh_missing: SSHCardAgent.exe was not found; please install it first.
msg_tray_hidden: The app is minimized to the tray: click the tray icon to show the window, right-click it to exit.
msg_set_startup_tip: When enabled the app starts automatically at logon and goes straight to the tray (the main window is not shown). Because it needs administrator rights, autostart is registered as a scheduled task so no UAC prompt appears at logon.
msg_set_startup_app: Start this app at logon (minimized to tray)
msg_set_startup_agent: Start the WinSSH agent at logon
msg_set_startup_task: Enabled: starts at logon (scheduled task, no UAC prompt)
msg_set_startup_run: Enabled: starts at logon (registry Run key, one UAC prompt)
msg_set_startup_fail: Could not change the autostart setting. Make sure the app runs as administrator and that scheduled tasks are not blocked, then try again.
msg_fido_tip: When enabled, "Use a security key / passkey" in the browser is served by the local TPM virtual smart card: a card + PIN dialog appears, and the private key is encrypted with the card PIN plus machine-bound DPAPI before being stored on this system (never in plaintext). Card backups include those credentials. The virtual bus driver must be installed once (kernel driver, admin required).
msg_fido_auto: Start FIDO2 automatically with this app
msg_fido_none: No FIDO2 credentials yet. Open a passkey-enabled site in a browser, choose "security key / another device", pick the card and enter the PIN to register.
msg_fido_confirm_delete: Delete this FIDO2 credential? The site can no longer be signed in with this card until you register again.
msg_fido_confirm_clear: Clear all FIDO2 credentials of this card? This cannot be undone.
msg_fido_installing: Installing the driver, this may take a while…
msg_fido_driver_missing: The virtual bus driver is not installed. Click "Install / repair virtual bus driver" first. If Windows rejects the signature, the self-test output shows the signature diagnostics.
msg_fido_need_select: Select a credential in the list first.
msg_fido_rewrap_fail:
PIN changed, but re-wrapping the FIDO2 credentials failed:
%s
msg_fido_unblock_lost: PIN unblocked, but the key derived from the old PIN is unavailable, so existing FIDO2 credentials cannot be used (register again).
